identitySignals: Name match: the organization's own website brands it 'Oakland Trybe', and its legal name in ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer is 'Trybe Inc' (EIN 46-4328520), a tax-exempt nonprofit in Oakland, CA
Location: its address is in Oakland, CA, which matches the agenda location
Mission fit: a community-based youth and family nonprofit in East Oakland, consistent with an OUSD workplace-training partner MOU for the High School Linked Learning Office's career program
No page I fetched mentions OUSD directly, so the OUSD link rests on name, city and mission fit
research.notes: The California Secretary of State entity number and SAM.gov UEI were not looked up, so they are null. The website also lists a separate donation and mailing address: 3542 Fruitvale Ave, #135, Oakland, CA 94602-2327. I used the physical address. An unrelated, similarly named organization, Friends of Trybe Ecotherapy Inc, also appeared in search results, and I did not use it.

profile.summary: Trybe (Oakland Trybe) is a community-based nonprofit rooted in East Oakland. It works with youth and families through programs and resources meant to strengthen families and the community.

review.notes: The site oaklandtrybe.org calls itself Trybe Inc., a community-based nonprofit in East Oakland, and lists the cited Oakland address, phone and general info@ email. Its youth internship and job-readiness programs fit OUSD's workplace-training MOU, and ProPublica lists Trybe Inc in Oakland, CA as a 501(c)(3) with EIN 46-4328520. No source mentions OUSD, and the EIN is tied to the website only by the matching name and city, but nothing points to a different organization, and the summary is supported and neutral.
